evidence.notes: Existing materializers know their SQL writer identity but cannot attest actual AI agent identity.

root_cause: Seven canonical PostgreSQL materializer functions do not include their own provable writer component identity in event payloads. Originating AI agent/skill identity is not available in historical source action evidence.
safe_fix: Annotate only future, new canonical cycle events with the explicitly known SQL function writer_component, writer_contract_version and agent_attribution=UNKNOWN_NOT_ATTESTED; preserve original grant/search_path/trigger and idempotent event order.
next_step: After protected migration, independently verify SQL function source and new events from existing schedules. Then instrument actor identity and actual baseline/outcomes in originating authorized agents before closing the candidate.
closure_gate: independently verified agent_id/skill_version, before/after metric evidence, provider outcome and commercial revenue attribution; this migration alone does not close the gate
